data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 closed 2017 with opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 27.621m. The syndicate reports a net favourable re-assessment of prior accident years equal to a GBP 3.7m surplus (net release), representing approximately a 13.4% release relative to opening gross claims. This prior-year improvement is described as arising from a reassessment of claims for earlier accident years (favourable claims development). Separately, 2017 experienced several large natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, California wildfires and Mexico earthquakes) which materially impacted the 2017 underwriting result, but the quantified prior-year movement reported is a net release.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.7m (2016: GBP 1.9m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

2017 was notable for the unprecedented level of large catastrophes that occurred, and Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, as well as the wildfires in California caused significant losses to the account.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross amount not explicitly provided. The report explicitly states a net surplus of GBP 3.7m relating to reassessment of prior accident years (this extraction uses that net figure as a last-resort fallback because no gross prior-year movement figure was provided). A gross claims development triangle is present but its layout/labels made direct extraction of a gross PYD ambiguous; therefore the net figure was used and flagged. Opening reserves taken from balance sheet (gross claims outstanding, 2016 comparative).
